reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001108 (the melody read from 001108a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 18); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Johann Cruger's dates (1598–1662) are from our page for the tune AUF, AUF, MEIN HERZ MIT FREUDEN (content/hymns/tunes/auf-auf-mein-herz-mit-freuden.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1656. Johann Sebastian Bach's dates (1685–1750) are from our page for the tune POTSDAM (content/hymns/tunes/potsdam.json); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001108a.nwc).
